answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 166564 Country: India Title: Is seeking Allah's mercy through wasilah of auliya necessary? Question: Is seeking Allah's mercy through wasilah of auliya necessary? Answer ID: 166564 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 222/174/SD=03/1440) It is not mandatory to supplicate Allah through the mediation of pious people, rather it is good. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
